column1: # Generated by tools/kpi-scan.py.  Symbols crossing the boundary between gpl/ (GPL-2.0 module) and drm/ + i915/ in the Gen9 closure.

# direction gpl->main: defined in gpl/, used by drm/ or i915/ (the GPL module must export it, or it is header-only code compiled into the other module); main->gpl: defined in drm/ or i915/, used by gpl/.  via=header means a macro, inline, type or prototype from a header: compiled into the user, no symbol crosses at link time.
